answer: Enclave attestation with a heartbeat: each identity is sealed to a hardware chip at registration, then must sign an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 7 epochs before transacting. A newcomer who cannot wait posts a 142-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum, and if either side farms duplicates both bonds are slashed and the seat burned. Forging 6 identities costs 6 real chips plus the bonds, and the hollow of quotes is published for re-verification while the signal window lets anyone challenge a stale quote; the crystal of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
